label: Inline Valve
iwEaNote: corrected 23Aug26 from IW-A — a valve provides no connection point, so it cannot be IW-A

artifactType.reason: SETTLED 1Sep26 by project decision: PART. Same reasoning as edes:GD-PIP -- GD-VLV's stem and its :smid junction (where 3 members meet) had pushed it toward Assembly and left this field open with candidate=Assembly, but a valve stem is not independently placeable; it is part of the valve as delivered. Supersedes the previous open state.

note: first component NOT in the ThickPipeBody family — subclasses Component directly

designCode.status: OPEN — does not fit edes:shared.designCode rule
designCode.reason: valve body is pipe-shaped (would read DNV) but is a pressure-containing mechanical component with its own governing standard (API 6D / ASME B16.34), which DNV-ST-F101 does not cover
designCode.consequence: no governing standard for EDPR to check compliance against until settled

scope.noTaper: NO taper on either transition, BY DESIGN (source: 'NO TAPERS anywhere') — not a simplification, IS the profile: a valve is a forging with flanged/welded ends
scope.noCompliantSibling: unlike GD-TP/GD-TT, nowhere to switch to
scope.consequence: any S-lay passage sweep of a GD-VLV over a roller roster models a passage that does not physically happen; contact_at remains correct for a STATIC bearing case only

free.name: L_body
free.meaning: AXIAL LENGTH of the valve body, along the pipeline.

free.name: OD_body
free.meaning: OUTSIDE DIAMETER of the valve body -- larger than the header pipe, which is what creates the shoulder.
free.note: FREE — the whole reason GD-VLV, not GD-TP/GD-TT, can represent a real valve

free.name: t_body
free.meaning: WALL THICKNESS of the valve body.

free.name: L_trans
free.meaning: AXIAL LENGTH of the transition at each end, between header OD and body OD.

free.name: t_trans
free.meaning: WALL THICKNESS through the transition zone.

free.name: L_stem
free.meaning: LENGTH of the valve stem, measured from the pipe centreline outward (transverse, not along the pipe).

free.name: m_extra
free.meaning: ADDED MASS not accounted for by the modelled geometry -- actuator, gearbox, trim. A lump, not a dimension.
free.note: MUST exclude body/transition/stem steel (already distributed element mass via real Sections) — actuator/gearbox/bonnet/trim/seats/packing only

derived.name: ID_body
derived.note: consequence not input; NOTHING bounds it vs pipeline bore

derived.name: halfExtent
derived.expr: halfExtent = L_body/2 + L_trans  (body plus one transition each side)
derived.meaning: HALF the component's axial footprint. extent = (centre_x - halfExtent, centre_x + halfExtent). Needed to place this component adjacent to another -- see edas:shared#/chaining.

geometry.note: FIRST non-chain topology — 3 members meet at :smid (2 run segments + stem). :smid satisfies the junction rule BY COINCIDENCE with a section-driven mandatory node; still must be DECLARED not inferred.
geometry.squareShoulders: FIXED 30Aug26 (was VLV-D1) — coincident node pairs (bodyL/bodyLs etc) + vertical riser geometry line, normal_is_collinear_with_offset=False. Geometry-vs-contact mismatch now 0.0 (was 0.164m/73%).
geometry.idConvention: RESOLVED 30 Aug 2026. structural_nodes() converged from the retired per-name '.replace(:,:s)' to _s_id() -- same rule GD-TP/TT/PIP use. Verified no-op on current node names (none contain an internal colon); removes a second mechanism doing one job, not a behaviour change.
geometry.nodeCountInvariant: geometry_nodes()=8, structural_nodes()=6 -- DELIBERATE, not drift. geometry carries a coincident pair at each square shoulder (VLV-D1, contact surface needs 2 y-values at 1 x); structural centreline never bifurcates, so 1 node per step suffices for a beam element's section to switch. Verified: structural_lines() has zero dangling references against the shorter list.

sectionClaim.verified: section_at() returns Section(OD=0.8128) at centre_x on STD_PIPELINE, VERIFIED LIVE; contact_at() returns a real Contact over the extent.
sectionClaim.consequence: THIS COMPONENT MAY NOT OVERLAP ANY OTHER SECTION-CLAIMING COMPONENT. If the header is modelled explicitly as edes:GD-HdPipe segments, the chain must be SPLIT around this valve and welded to it on both sides -- a header segment spanning it is a section conflict that no ownership setting resolves. Contrast edes:GD-SH, which may overlap freely because it claims no section.
sectionClaim.inTheWeldChain: GD-VLV is in ils_builder.INLINE_CODES: it welds to its neighbours at weldL/weldR and is included in gap checking.

constraints.repair: increase t_trans (OD_trans is derived from it)
reduce t_body, or increase OD_body — wall currently leaves no bore
clear m_extra or supply a non-negative value

constraintEquivalence.method: probe vs live validate(), no inherited rules (subclasses Component directly)

nonConstraints: ID_body unbounded vs pipeline bore — a valve cavity NARROWER than the line builds without complaint
stem unconstrained vs body (thicker/wider than body possible)

assemblyFeatures.status: the mate points an adjacent component ties to are weldL/weldR, VERIFIED LIVE 1Sep26 against component_spec.Valve.geometry_nodes(). The other six stations (bodyL, bodyLs, mid, bodyRs, bodyR, stemTip) are internal -- bodyL/bodyR are the OD step, bodyLs/bodyRs the shoulder, mid the stem junction (:smid), stemTip the free stem end. None of these is a chain mate point: a join naming any of them would place the neighbour inside this component's own extent.
assemblyFeatures.stemTipIsNotAMatePoint: stemTip is the ONLY node on this component at NodePriority.PREFERRED rather than MANDATORY, and it terminates free -- it is the tip of the valve stem, not a connection to anything. Contrast edes:GD-B, whose own free-looking 'end' station IS a real mate point (it ties to a GD-ST/GD-SB connector slot via support_connector). Same visual shape in a node list, opposite meaning.
assemblyFeatures.strictnessCaveat: whether these are OAMFeatures in NISTIR 7436's strict sense or merely Features depends on whether the component is mated in a given layout -- see edes:shared#/frameworks OAM.usedButLooser.AssemblyFeature candidacy.

behaviourDerived.mechanism: large abrupt stiffness+diameter step, same family as GD-TP's step, scaled up
behaviourDerived.loadPath: first topology where the shared distribution-factor rule does non-trivial work WITHOUT a connector — :smid genuinely splits load 3 ways (2 run + stem) in any assembled model today
behaviourDerived.pointMasses: IMPLEMENTED 30Aug26 (was VLV-D3, absent). Defaults []. COG fixed at :smid (mid of body, already mandatory). A real valve's COG offset toward the actuator (above axis) is NOT representable — point_masses returns no coordinates.

rollerContact.scope: run only — stem owns no contact, rises to negative y

usedInLayouts.note: Back-links to worked layouts containing this component, generated mechanically from the layout library on 1Sep26 -- not hand-written, so they cannot drift from it by authoring error, though they WILL go stale if the library changes and this is not regenerated. Their purpose is placement guidance: this file describes what the component IS and what its own constraints are, but says nothing about where along a header to put one or what to put either side of it. A worked archetype answers that by example. paramsUsed are the archetype's own values verbatim; anchors are published table rows that override them.
usedInLayouts.absent: no archetype in standard_ils_layouts.json contains this component. That is not necessarily a gap in the library -- it may simply never have been the subject of a published study -- but it does mean there is no worked layout to copy parameter values or placement from, so an LLM configuring one has this component's own constraints and nothing else to go on.

regressionCase.finding: GD-VLV represents it EXACTLY — verified: proudOverD=0.584, EIratio=41.75, both match true values to the digit
regressionCase.contrast: GD-TP/GD-TT both return OD_comp=0.4176 for the same case — free OD_body is the whole difference

openQuestions: design code for a valve — API 6D/ASME B16.34, not the shared DNV/ASME rule

defects.summary: structural_nodes() used the retired .replace(':',':s') pattern instead of _s_id()
defects.fix: converged to _s_id(); verified identical output on all current node names

inputsRequired.readAlso: edes:shared -- REQUIRED, not optional. No inherited parameters -- this component subclasses Component directly.

headerPipeline.OD_pipe: REQUIRED, metres -- the HEADER pipeline outside diameter
headerPipeline.why: No default exists for either. This component's parameters, defaults and constraints are evaluated against the pipe it is built on; without both, none of them can be resolved.

componentParams.required: none beyond placement -- every free parameter has a usable default

optional.OD_body: defaults to 2.0*OD_pipe. FREE — the whole reason GD-VLV, not GD-TP/GD-TT, can represent a real valve
optional.m_extra: defaults to None. kg. MUST exclude body/transition/stem steel (already distributed element mass via real Sections) — actuator/gearbox/bonnet/trim/seats/packing only

placement.centre_x: REQUIRED to place the component. EDES gives NO guidance on the value. No archetype in the layout library contains this component, so there is NO worked precedent to take a value from -- query.

inputsRequired.ifMissing: Anything listed as required, having no default, and not supplied by the person must be QUERIED. Do not assume a value and do not carry one over from a worked example -- a precedent shows what was once chosen, not what this case needs.

assemblyRef: edas:shared -- assembly-level knowledge this file deliberately does not carry: build sequence, id convention, the chaining equation, ownership arbitration, section-vs-contact, association format and the emit format.
